title: Weche Mag Mirima
stanzas: Weche mag mirima mondo Kik pusre a e dhowa;Paro maber mond` ogeng`gi Ka pok giwuok e dhowa.
Wach marach jawuok mapiyo, To gin gik maduwo chuny;Gi maketho osiep kindwa, To weche mag mirima.
Hera ler kendo olong`o, Kik wayie ketho osiep;Nikech wach marach mwapuso; Ber mondo warit dhowa.
chorus: "Heroreuru," Ruodhwa owacho;Nyithindo winjuru chik mar Wuoro;(Herreuru, herreuru, Winjuru chik mar Wuoro;), "Heroreuru," Ruodhwa owacho; Nyithindo, winjuru chikne, (Herreuru, herreuru, Winjuru chikne.)
